entries.en: to face each other; to stand face to face

entries.zh: 对质论理；据理辩明真相
entries.en: to confront arguments; to argue a matter out to the truth
entries.notes: source_L 为残损缩写（"carcar se dr a saber la uer dad"），按 carear(se) de razón "a saber la verdad" 释读，故降置信。

entries.en: to carry (a load) between two bearers; to shoulder-carry
entries.notes: R 栏 "Seng." 标记来源不明，取义依靠 "căng" 与西语 "entre dos"。

entries.en: to carry on a shoulder-pole; to shoulder a load
entries.notes: source_L "carjar 2n un impalo doraç" 残损，疑为 "en un palo de arroz"，仅取肩挑义。

entries.en: to carry or lift (something) with the hands
entries.notes: source_H 作"擀"，与西语"以手搬运"不合，疑为攑/掮一类字，释义从西语与 R 栏。

entries.zh: 用牲口驮载；把货物驮上马
entries.en: to load on a pack animal; to carry (cargo) on a beast
to drive a carriage; to harness and drive
entries.notes: source_H 仅单字"駕"，据 M 栏 gâce（駕車）补足为驾车义。

entries.en: to press; to squeeze; to press down (a load)
to load a ship; to take in cargo

entries.zh: 装货落船；把货物装上船
entries.en: to put cargo aboard; to load into the ship's hold
entries.notes: source_H "下落船" 中"落船"兼有装船、登船两解，此处依西语 cargar el navío 取装货义。

entries.zh: 灌铅骰子；作弊用的加重骰
entries.en: loaded dice; dice weighted with lead
entries.notes: source_H 带 [疑:骸] 字残，R 栏 "çēn çēn" 重复疑衍，义据"灌鉛骰"与西语 cargar el dado 定。

entries.en: (of a mother) to carry a small child in her arms; to bear a child along
entries.notes: source_H 带 [疑:身]，source_L "cvd ompañio" 残损，取义据 M 栏 pŏ̃g sēy guīa（抱細囝）与西语。

entries.zh: 给火绳枪装药；装填枪械
entries.en: to load an arquebus; to charge a firearm

entries.zh: 挑夫；脚夫（挑担运货的人）

entries.en: to work as a porter; to hire oneself out as a coolie
entries.notes: M 栏附异文 ": chose"，且"脚"的 M/R 对音不一致，故降置信。

entries.zh: 夫马；差役挑夫与驮马（运输人夫）
entries.en: bearers and horses (corvée transport); transport hands
entries.notes: source_H "夫馬" 为差役运输的复合词，非单纯"挑夫"，与西语 cargador 仅部分相合。

entries.en: sedan-chair shop; chair-stand where chairs are hired
entries.notes: source_H "轎埔" 带 [疑]，疑为"轎舖"；source_L "carga de si Vla." 残，据 carga de silla 推读，义难定谳。
source_H 带 [疑:薦夫]，source_L 残损，取义据"轎夫"与西语 carga de silla。
source_H 带 [疑:薦脚]，与 position 18 义近，疑为同义异称。
